description: This file defines a Java class 'PreAuthenticatedAuthenticationProvider' responsible for handling pre-authentication logic in a security context. It checks specific HTTP headers and request parameters to identify pre-authenticated subjects, constructs authorization contexts, and provides authentication results based on this information.

classes.name: PreAuthenticatedAuthenticationProvider
classes.description: Final class providing pre-authentication based on specific request headers or parameters. Extends 'TimeMeasuringAuthenticationProvider' and implements singleton pattern. Handles authentication success or failure and constructs related authorization contexts.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the provider.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Checks if the current request context contains relevant pre-authentication headers.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the authorization context type for the request.
